scope: Prompt TSG task-semantics extraction and evidence-coordinate validity only; no query, intervention arm, generated code, Oracle output, or effect outcome is changed.

clarifications.rule: A task that predetermines one named tool or a fixed pipeline of named tools and lets the caller supply only arguments satisfies constraint.fixed_executable; a finite executable domain is used only when the caller chooses among tools.

Binary/object serialization, framework checkpoints, and loader-specific formats are not Python-literal text. When a prompt states an unsupported format, the extractor omits YAML, JSON, and Python-literal semantics instead of choosing the nearest registered format.

Every returned occurrence index must be within the exact substring count in source_prompt; the proposer must choose a longer exact unique span when a short span is repeated or its occurrence count is uncertain.
